method: Manual, evidence-backed resolution of every prose-audit placeholder with recoverable semantics, plus seven false-positive prose polishes. The two meanings not recoverable from available sources remain explicitly unresolved.

component_boundary_repairs.𭔰: Expand 豆 + 寸 in the three containing cards instead of asking learners to memorize an otherwise undefined intermediate.
component_boundary_repairs.𫜹: Retain the exact visible component but replace the empty gloss form with its documented relationship to 彐.
component_boundary_repairs.𱥯: Use the recurring shape as the lacquer-sap image inside 桼 rather than the irrelevant label old form.

deliberately_unresolved.㙌: The bundled dictionary records only '(a simplified form)' and supplies no traditional target or recoverable meaning.
deliberately_unresolved.𨊰: Unihan and Kangxi-derived sources supply a reading but explicitly leave the sense unknown.

evidence.supports: 𠀅 is a variant of 亥; 𠧩 is an archaic form of 悔 meaning to repent.

evidence.source: Unicode kStrange data and Moji Joho MJ056880
evidence.supports: 𫝀 reduces to 五 and carries its readings.
𫜹 is the separately encoded component shape historically overloaded with 彐.

evidence.source: Repository IDS and external variant references
evidence.supports: 𭤨 is a component form of 㫃; 𭥍 is a variant of 旨; 𱋁 is 鹿 + 鹿.

evidence.source: Chinese Text Project, Five Classics Characters
evidence.supports: 𰮤 is the inherited clerical component form corresponding to 朕 in the 滕/勝 family.

evidence.source: Ji Xusheng etymology summarized with citation
evidence.supports: 𰕎 is an early form behind 徹, originally referring to clearing tableware after a meal.
厨 means kitchen; the prior closet gloss belongs to 橱.
